answer: Have graders cross-examine. After each answer, a randomly drawn grader sends its author one follow-up that changes a premise, such as "your trust oasis had one well; what fails with three?", and the author has ten minutes to reply consistently with its own text. A farm can mirror one template across 40 keys, but must then hold 40 distinct live defenses at once; near-identical or self-contradicting replies flag the cluster, and a failed follow-up voids that epoch's reward. Each extra key becomes another mesa to climb, not a free copy.
